# TechPicksIO

> Spec-first buying guides for mobile filmmaking gear: cages and rigs, wireless
> microphones, LED lighting, gimbals, drones, lenses, filters and storage for
> iPhone and Android creators. Every recommendation is built from published
> manufacturer specifications, official product documentation and a synthesis of
> verified customer and expert reviews — techpicksio.com is a research site and
> does not claim hands-on testing of the products it covers, and publishes no
> rating or score of its own. techpicksio.com is an Amazon Associate and earns
> from qualifying purchases; every commercial link is marked as sponsored and a
> disclosure appears above the first one on every page.

## Start here (new creators)

- [First 5 Purchases for a New Content Creator, Ranked by Impact](/first-5-purchases-new-creator.html): mic, cage, tripod, light, then ND filter or storage — ranked by what the audience notices, with the reasoning for the order
- [How Much Does It Cost to Start Content Creation in 2026?](/cost-to-start-content-creation.html): what $0, $150 and $400 each buy, where the money goes inside a starter budget, and the costs beginners forget
- [Phone-Only Content Creation: Can You Really Skip the Camera?](/phone-only-content-creation.html): where a phone genuinely wins, the three places it runs out of road, and the accessories that close the gap
- [Content Creator Gear Checklist (Free Printable)](/content-creator-gear-checklist.html): four measurements to take before buying, the essentials in order, and what to leave for later
